stem:
Diya studies a garden plant. It is shorter than a tree. It has many hard brown woody stems that branch close to the ground.

How should she classify the plant?

options.text: Shrub — many hard brown woody stems branch close to the ground.
Tree — it has hard brown woody stems.
Herb — it is shorter than a tree.
Creeper — stems that branch close to the ground mean it creeps.

teacher.key_rationale: Many hard brown woody stems branching close to the ground, and shorter than a tree, match shrub — not tree, herb, or climber.
